patch:
diff --git a/rich/console.py b/rich/console.py
index 5929fb1c..ee8df39f 100644
--- a/rich/console.py
+++ b/rich/console.py
@@ -731,11 +731,15 @@ class Console:
             if no_color is not None
             else self._environ.get("NO_COLOR", "") != ""
         )
-        self.is_interactive = (
-            (self.is_terminal and not self.is_dumb_terminal)
-            if force_interactive is None
-            else force_interactive
-        )
+        tty_interactive = self._environ.get("TTY_INTERACTIVE", "")
+        if force_interactive is not None:
+            self.is_interactive = force_interactive
+        elif tty_interactive == "0":
+            self.is_interactive = False
+        elif tty_interactive == "1":
+            self.is_interactive = True
+        else:
+            self.is_interactive = self.is_terminal and not self.is_dumb_terminal
 
         self._record_buffer_lock = threading.RLock()
         self._thread_locals = ConsoleThreadLocals(
diff --git a/rich/live.py b/rich/live.py
index 85faca80..d87c3c10 100644
--- a/rich/live.py
+++ b/rich/live.py
@@ -54,7 +54,7 @@ class Live(JupyterMixin, RenderHook):
         *,
         console: Optional[Console] = None,
         screen: bool = False,
-        auto_refresh: bool = True,
+        auto_refresh: Optional[bool] = None,
         refresh_per_second: float = 4,
         transient: bool = False,
         redirect_stdout: bool = True,
@@ -75,7 +75,11 @@ class Live(JupyterMixin, RenderHook):
 
         self._lock = RLock()
         self.ipy_widget: Optional[Any] = None
-        self.auto_refresh = auto_refresh
+        self.auto_refresh = (
+            auto_refresh
+            if auto_refresh is not None
+            else self.console.is_interactive
+        )
         self._started: bool = False
         self.transient = True if screen else transient
